newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico 1996 tortilla production flat - industry.
newsitem.headline: Mexico 1996 tortilla production flat - industry.

text.p: Mexico is on course to produce a total of six million tonnes of tortillas in 1996, similar to 1995 figures, an industry spokesman told Reuters on Tuesday.

"Whereas tortilla production may not grow due to the (economic) crisis, it will hold steady at 1995 levels, or six million tonnes," said Jesus Fonseca, organization secretary of the Confederation of Corn Flour and Tortilla Industries.
Tortillas are pancakes made from maize flour that have been a staple of the Mexican diet for centuries.
